title: Testing Agentic Service Systems: An Agentic Living Lab Methodology Across the Physical-Digital Continuum
abstract: arXiv:2610.35978v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Task success is insufficient for testing agents that act for principals, change persistent business state, and affect physical processes: a useful result may be unauthorized, leave obligations unresolved, or depend on the execution substrate. We propose an Agentic Living Lab methodology organized around three questions: what is the test unit, who and what participate, and under what reality is the test executed? The unit is a service episode containing delegated roles, obligations, world state, and evidence. The method separates agents under test from environment actors and distinguishes real humans, human traces, rule surrogates, and agent-based proxies. Realization Profiles, capability-declared Reality Substrate bindings, Grounding Profiles, and Semantic Delta disclosures make changes across software, enterprise systems, simulation, and physical settings explicit. translated_title: 测试智能体服务系统：跨越物理-数字连续体的智能体生活实验室方法论
translated_abstract: 对于那些代表委托人行事、改变持久业务状态并影响物理过程的智能体而言，仅有任务成功是不够的：一个有用的结果可能是未经授权的、留下未解决的义务，或者依赖于执行基底。我们提出了一种“智能体生活实验室”方法论，围绕三个问题组织：什么是测试单元、谁和什么参与测试、以及在何种现实下执行测试？测试单元是一个服务片段，其中包含委托角色、义务、世界状态和证据。该方法将被测智能体与环境参与者分离，并区分真实人类、人类痕迹、规则替代物和基于智能体的代理。实现配置文件、声明能力的现实基底绑定、接地配置文件和语义差异披露使跨越软件、企业系统、仿真和物理环境的变更变得明确。一个四平面参考架构分离了实验控制、参与者……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种“智能体生活实验室”测试方法论，以服务片段为测试单元、区分被测智能体与环境参与者，并通过显式的现实基底绑定与语义差异披露，解决智能体服务系统在物理-数字连续体上超越单纯任务成功的授权、义务与执行环境依赖等测试难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes an Agentic Living Lab methodology that uses service episodes as test units and explicit Reality Substrate bindings to test agentic service systems across the physical-digital continuum, addressing authorization, obligations, and execution-environment dependencies beyond mere task success.
